products.name: Browser Based POS
products.headline: Free offline POS, right in your browser
products.description: A completely free point-of-sale for small businesses. Bill customers, manage products and inventory, hold and recall carts, and print thermal receipts — no login, no subscription, and it keeps working without internet. All data stays on your device, with one-click backup and restore.
features: Fast billing with barcode scanner support
Works fully offline
Hold and recall carts mid-rush
Credit (udhaar) sales and customer ledger
Inventory & stock tracking with movement log
Customers & purchase history
Sales, payment and best-seller reports
Thermal (80mm/58mm) & A4 receipt printing
PIN counter lock with idle auto-lock
JSON backup / restore, CSV exports & Google Sheet sync

cta.label: Open Browser Based POS — it's free

products.name: Bank Statement Analyzer
products.headline: Free bank statement analysis, right in your browser
products.description: A completely free bank statement analyser for chartered accountants and anyone who keeps a set of books. Import a PDF, Excel or CSV statement, classify every transaction with rules you control, reconcile against your ledger and export CA reports — no login, no subscription, and the statement is never uploaded anywhere.
features: Imports PDF, XLSX, XLS and CSV — including password-protected PDFs
Nothing is uploaded: parsing and analysis run in your browser
Extraction checked against the statement's own running balance
Deterministic rules-based classification with visible confidence
Business, personal and transfer marking separate from the category
Several statements analysed together, with duplicates excluded
Monthly cash flow, expense, income and counterparty analysis
Cash, high-value, bank charge, interest and transfer reports
Ledger reconciliation with exact, date-window and fuzzy matching
Excel workbook, PDF report and CSV exports generated on device

cta.label: Open Bank Statement Analyzer — it's free

products.name: Free Dine
products.headline: A free restaurant POS that runs in your browser
products.description: A complete dining-room till, free and with no login. Tables and floor areas, bills that stay open for an hour, kitchen order tickets per round, and a live kitchen screen in a second tab. Split and merge bills, GST with the CGST/SGST breakup, raw-material stock driven by recipes, table bookings with WhatsApp confirmations, and udhaar through the shared Customer Ledger. Everything stays on your device, and it keeps billing with the internet down.
features: Tables and floor areas with live running totals
Open tickets that survive a browser restart
Kitchen order tickets per round, without prices
Live kitchen screen in a second tab, lockable as a kiosk
Half/full sizes and add-on groups
Split bills by item, share or amount — and merge tables
GST with per-item rates and CGST/SGST breakup
Raw-material stock with per-dish recipes and food cost
Table bookings, free or against an advance
WhatsApp confirmations and reminders from your own number
Credit (udhaar) posted to the shared Customer Ledger
Thermal (80mm/58mm) and A4 bills, designed in the Receipt Designer
Day summary, item report, hourly sales and printable day close
Backup, CSV exports and Google Sheet sync
Works offline, no login required

products.name: Setu QR Menu
products.headline: A QR code that never needs reprinting
products.description: Your menu lives online and the printed QR code holds only a short permanent link. Change a price, mark a dish sold out or swap in a seasonal menu — the code on your tables keeps working. Dish photos, sizes and variations, multiple menus and daily scan counts — free for your first year.
features: One permanent QR code, printed once
Instant price and menu changes
Sold-out toggles & dish photos
Sizes and variations per dish
Multiple menus you can switch between
Daily scan analytics
Hygiene grade and certificate on the menu
Three templates with editable colours

products.description: A completely free class manager for a tuition teacher. Students and batches, daily attendance, monthly fees that add themselves up, WhatsApp reminders to parents, test marks and shareable fee receipts — no login, no subscription, and it keeps working without internet.
features: Batch-wise daily attendance in seconds
Works fully offline
Automatic monthly fee dues, concessions and one-off charges
Numbered fee receipts with shareable links and UPI payment
WhatsApp fee reminders and absence notices to parents
Tests with whole-batch marks entry and result sharing
Student-left handling that stops fees but keeps the history

Bulk student import, PIN lock, backup and Google Sheet sync

products.name: Free Clinic Manager
products.headline: Free clinic and prescription software, right in your browser
products.description: A completely free clinic manager for a single doctor or a small practice. Prescriptions that print as sharp, selectable text, patient records with vitals and history, appointments on a live day screen, and billing with automatic follow-up fees and UPI receipts — no login, no subscription, no patient limit, and it keeps working without internet.
features: Prescriptions printed as real selectable text, A4 or A5
Protocols — save a whole prescription, load it on the next patient in one tap
Complaints, findings and diagnosis autocomplete from your own past writing
Vitals with BMI computed as you type and the last reading shown
One day screen in token order, with live wait timers
Appointments inside your own hours, with WhatsApp reminders in one run
Follow-ups booked on finalise, plus a report of who has not returned
Follow-up fees applied automatically inside your window
Numbered receipts on 58mm, 80mm or A4, with a UPI QR to pay from
Dues tracking with WhatsApp reminders to patients
Investigation slips printed as a separate signed A5
Patient charts with weight and BP trends, and bulk register import
Footfall, revenue, top diagnoses and no-show reports, all exportable to CSV
Works fully offline — PIN lock, backup / restore and Google Sheet sync

products.name: Free Token System
products.headline: Free token and display software, right in your browser
products.description: A completely free token system for anywhere people wait in a line — clinics, labs, salons, service centres, bank branches. Hand out numbers, put a display screen in the waiting area, and let the app call each person out loud in Hindi, English or your own language. No login, no subscription, and it keeps working without internet.
features: Calls the number out loud — “Token A forty-two, please proceed to Counter three”
Announcements in Hindi, English, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati and Kannada
A waiting-room display for a TV or second monitor, in light, dark or high contrast
Chime and a flashing card for screens with no speech engine
Several services and counters, with priority for seniors and emergencies
Recall, skip and transfer — the token number stays with the person
Honest wait estimates from your own measured service times
Token slips on a 58mm printer, and an A4 QR poster for the waiting area
WhatsApp the token and an “almost your turn” nudge
Hourly load, no-show rate and counter-wise reports, exportable to CSV
Works fully offline — PIN lock, backup / restore and Google Sheet sync

products.name: Free Rental & Hire Book
products.headline: Free rental management software for tent houses and equipment hire
products.description: A completely free hire book for tent houses, event decorators, furniture and party equipment rental, camera hire and construction tool hire. It tracks what is committed on every date, so you never promise the same 200 chairs to two weddings — and it settles damage, shortage and late fees against the deposit when the stock comes back. No login, no subscription, works offline.
features: An availability calendar that answers “how many are free on the 14th?” in seconds
Free counts on the tightest single day of a range — never an average that hides a clash
A conflict list that surfaces every booking promising more stock than you own
Enquiry → confirmed → dispatched → returned, with a quotation at the front
Picking lists for the loading crew with no prices on them, and signed delivery challans
Return settlement: damaged, lost and late, all charged against the deposit
Per-item utilisation and return on cost — what to buy more of, what to sell off
Serial-numbered units for cameras and tools, one booking at a time, enforced
Maintenance logs that take stock out of availability while it is being repaired
WhatsApp quotes, confirmations and overdue chases with a link the customer can open
Works fully offline — PIN lock, backup / restore and Google Sheet sync

products.name: Free Repair Job Card
products.headline: Free repair shop software with job cards, photos and a condition record
products.description: A completely free job card app for mobile, laptop and appliance repair shops. Records the device's condition with photographs and a signature the moment it comes in, so “that scratch wasn't there before” ends there — then tracks every device on one board that turns amber and red as jobs sit. No login, no subscription, works offline.
features: Intake in ninety seconds: condition checklist, camera photos and a customer signature
An intake record that cannot be edited after the job is saved — that is the whole point
A board of every device in the shop, ageing to amber and red as the days pass
Search by IMEI, job number, phone or name, matching part of a serial as well as all of it
WhatsApp updates at every stage, from your own templates, sent by you rather than automatically
Job slip at A5 or 58mm, plus a device tag with the job number big enough to read across a bench
Parts stock with cost beside selling price, so the margin is visible while it can still be changed
Delivery with payment, signature and an invoice carrying the warranty expiry date
Warranty lookup by job number or IMEI, and claims that do not count as new revenue
The uncollected list — finished work nobody came back for, totalled and chased on a cycle
Margin, turnaround, technician throughput and which supplier's parts keep coming back
Works fully offline — PIN lock, backup / restore and Google Sheet sync

products.name: Free Pharmacy POS
products.headline: Free pharmacy billing software for medical stores, with expiry tracking
products.description: A completely free billing and stock app for medical stores and chemist shops. Stock is held batch by batch rather than per medicine, so the counter always sells the strip that expires first, the batch number prints on the bill, and an expiry dashboard tells you what is about to be worthless while the distributor will still take it back. No login, no subscription, works offline.
features: Batch-wise stock with month-precision expiry on every strip in the shop
Billing that picks the oldest-expiring batch and splits a quantity across batches by itself
An expiry dashboard bucketed by 30, 60 and 90 days, valued at what the stock cost you
Return lists grouped by supplier, with one tap to create the return note
One search box across brand name, salt and barcode, with same-salt substitutes
Distributor invoice entry in packs, with scheme goods costed into a blended rate
Prescription capture for Schedule H, H1 and X, and a printable scheduled-sales register
Margin read off the batch each sale actually drew from, not an average
GST summary by rate, stock value, movers and a suggested order list by supplier
Refill reminders and udhaar balances, sent on WhatsApp from your own templates
Works fully offline — PIN lock, backup / restore and Google Sheet sync
